report: Doing Business 2005, historical cross-section as originally published
units: Calendar days to complete legal startup procedures for the standardized business case; not a population survey of all startups

brazil_update.note: Displayed rounded to 17 days, separately dated. Changes in coverage and methodology mean this is not a harmonized estimate of a causal reform effect.

note: Doing Business was discontinued in September 2021. Historical data must not be presented as current conditions.
comparison_note: Original Doing Business 2005 report compared with 2019 observations from the World Bank WDI archive preserved by OWID. Earlier report edition is not observation year 2005; evolving methodology and geographical coverage limit strict comparability.
